name: Rudrapur

queries.query: Rudrapur Uttarakhand official cadastral parcel map land records GIS viewer
queries.result: First-party results identified the Uttarakhand Stamps and Registration GIS portal, the department's e-Registration property-services portal, the Government of India's NAKSHA urban land-mapping portal, and official Rudrapur/Urban Development pages. No anonymous Rudrapur parcel-ID-plus-geometry response was found.

queries.query: रुद्रपुर उत्तराखंड आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा मानचित्र भूलेख
queries.result: First-party discovery surfaced Uttarakhand's official e-Registration/GIS services and the national NAKSHA portal; no Rudrapur-specific public cadastral vector endpoint or native parcel identity was exposed.

registryBasis: The first-party Uttarakhand Stamps and Registration GIS/property portal is a local state property-registration map/procedure custodian, and its public ArcGIS map query intersected the exact WUP point with Rudrapur administrative/circle-rate records. This is not evidence of an open cadastral parcel layer.

officialSources.observation: Public Uttarakhand GIS application portal; links to the Citizen Portal and help documentation.
Current Web AppBuilder configuration points to public Web Map item 3cccaa6a8cb54d3990d471d30a252a88.
Operational map service is SRO_Circle_Rate_Main_Basemap; layers include roads, villages, wards and circle rates, but no cadastral parcel layer.
Official national NAKSHA portal describes urban GIS land mapping, but the public page is an application/login shell and did not expose an anonymous Rudrapur parcel response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttarakhand property-registration GIS with public circle-rate and administrative map layers; national NAKSHA urban land-mapping programme.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official public map configuration, service metadata, and a safe exact-point administrative circle-rate response only.

notes: Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order. No exact-point parcel hit/miss inference was made. A circle-rate polygon is not a cadastral parcel. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained. Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
